guide.greenlantern.cyborg.title: Cyborg
guide.greenlantern.cyborg:
§6Mother Box§r
Craft the §6Mother Box§r and right-click or press §eG§r to put on Cyborg's suit: an armored body that shrugs off blows and never takes fall damage.

§6Cyborg Battery§r
The powers and the thrusters spend battery, which slowly comes back on its own. Near powered redstone (a redstone block, torch or wire) it charges twice as fast, and a lightning bolt nearby fills it up. Under water it doesn't charge.

§6Thrusters§r
Double-tap jump to fire up the thrusters, like Superman and Wonder Woman: faster than her, slower than him. Flying spends battery; hovering doesn't.
guide.greenlantern.cyborg_powers.title: Powers
guide.greenlantern.cyborg_powers:
§6Sonic Cannon§r: The arm becomes a cannon and fires a sonic wave in a cone that damages, knocks back enemies and shatters glass and ice.
§6Shoulder Missiles§r: Four micro-rockets launch from the shoulder and chase the nearest enemies, exploding without breaking blocks.
§6Tech Scan§r: While on, highlights enemies and ores within 24 blocks through walls and shows the health of the target in sight. Costs per second.
§6Machine Hack§r: Hacks the machine in sight: an iron golem becomes an ally for a minute, doors, trapdoors and gates open (iron ones too), levers and buttons obey and minecarts shoot off.
§6EMP Burst§r: A pulse around him stuns enemies for a few seconds, grounds flying mobs and switches off nearby redstone for a moment.
§6Self Repair§r: Nanobots fix body and suit: heals over a few seconds and restores the suit's durability.
§6Boom Tube§r: Opens a tunnel of light that takes Cyborg and anyone near him to the marked point (sneak and use to mark it; without a mark, to the bed or spawn).
guide.greenlantern.controls_cyborg.title: Controls
guide.greenlantern.controls_cyborg:
§eRight click§r (Mother Box): put on the suit or use the power.
§eG§r: suit up / take the suit off.
§eDouble-tap jump§r: thrusters on / off.
§eW§r while flying: speed up. §eCtrl§r: speed up faster. §eS§r: air brake.
§eR§r (hold / tap): power wheel / next power.
§eV§r: use the selected power.
§eSneak + use§r with the Boom Tube: mark the destination.
